# BAD-004 — App Store Connect resubmission for iOS 1.0: App Privacy, age rating, review notes, subscriptions, and the reply to App Review

## Brief
Follow-up to BAD-002 (PR #330, merged). Eric asked Spud to fill in the resubmission in App Store Connect and the reply to App Review, in the in-app Browser pane, where Eric signs in himself.

In scope, per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-14-ios-app-review-guest-mode-design.md § 3.3 to § 3.6 and § 5:
- App Privacy: no tracking; remove Device ID, Advertising Data and Purchase History; keep Email, User ID, Coarse Location and User Content.
- Age rating: ads no, in-app purchases no; user-generated content stays yes.
- App Review Information notes: § 5.2 for the settled scope. All three catalog scenes (bubb-rubb-lil-sis, hide-yo-kids-hide-yo-wife, pakistan-is-in-da-bag) are marked anonymous as of 2026-09-14, so a guest downloads them without an account and the sample-file line is dropped. The public collab list is hidden on iOS, and the contact for reports is the address badtakes.io/privacy publishes. Eric types REVIEWER_CODE himself; it is the demo account's credential.
- The two subscriptions: remove them from the 1.0 submission if App Store Connect allows it; otherwise use the reply's fallback sentence.
- The Resolution Center reply, § 5.1: sent only with the resubmission, once build 0.13.4 (13004) is uploaded and attached.

Rules: Eric signs in; no member types a password, code or credential. Every Save, Publish, Send, Remove and Submit for Review needs Eric's explicit approval in chat, collected by Spud, before any member clicks it.

## Size, persona and model decision
One opus writer at a time, driving the in-app Browser pane in Eric's signed-in App Store Connect session. Tier raised from sonnet because a wrong value on an outward-facing Apple form costs a review cycle. A member fills fields and stops before any Save, Publish, Send or Submit. Spud gets Eric's approval for those in chat, and a second member clicks only the approved ones. The reply and Submit for Review wait for the 0.13.4 build.
